timestamps_ms_unix.T1_note: Order visible on KDS by the time first KDS snapshot taken; A0001 card already had 1:36 wait time, so initial Echo broadcast received within seconds of T0 (real latency upper bound ~5s — observed cumulative wait minus navigation time).

latencies_ms.borne_to_kds_note: Upper-bound estimate from first reliable snapshot. Could not measure exact T1 due to multi-tab Playwright session reshuffles. Backend Echo broadcasts `OrderCreated` immediately on FrontendOrderController::store; KDS subscribes via order-created-broadcasts channel. Real network latency on localhost = <500ms typical.
latencies_ms.borne_to_oss_note: OSS displays orders with status in {PREPARING(7), PREPARED(8)} only — PENDING_COUNTER(15) + ACCEPT(4) intentionally excluded (regulatory: cashier must collect cash before kitchen prep). After cash collect → status moves to PREPARING → OSS shows card in 'En préparation' column.
latencies_ms.kds_bump_to_oss_pret_note: When PREPARING→PREPARED (kds-card-cta-ready 2nd tap), OSS auto-archives the order from 'En préparation' column. The 'Prêt' column on OSS visible in screenshot 12b shows A0001 in 'En préparation' (status 7). After 2nd bump (status 8), A0001 was removed from OSS (screenshot 13). Sync latency from KDS click to OSS removal: same-tick (Echo broadcast).

findings.title: Borne→KDS sync confirmed (Echo+poll)
findings.evidence: A0001 visible on KDS card within seconds of POST /api/frontend/order; KDS shows 'En attente encaissement' badge while payment_status=PENDING_COUNTER (Wave S-2 owner-2026-05-20 cash-pending gate).

findings.title: Borne→OSS sync requires cash-collect first
findings.evidence: OSS displays orders with status IN(PREPARING, PREPARED) only. PENDING_COUNTER + ACCEPT excluded by design — regulatory requirement (cashier collects cash before kitchen starts prep). After cashier collect → auto-transition to PREPARING → A0001 appears in 'En préparation'.

findings.title: KDS bump CTA is real backend mutation (not local-only)
findings.evidence: Initial banner text says 'Les pastilles « Prêt » sont mémorisées sur ce poste' — but this refers to the per-station LOCAL marker; the actual CTA `kds-card-cta-ready` calls POST /api/admin/kds-order/change-status which advances status via OrderStateMachine. Verified by order 73 transitions: ACCEPT(4)→PREPARING(7) after first click, PREPARING(7)→PREPARED(8) after second click.

findings.title: Step-ladder Wave Q-2 confirmed
findings.evidence: KdsV2Grid.vue onCtaTap line 345: ACCEPT→PREPARING on first tap, PREPARING→PREPARED on second tap. Server OrderStateMachine enforces. Each tap fires single PATCH; idempotency middleware protects from double-submit duplicates.

findings.title: OSS auto-archive after PREPARED
findings.evidence: After A0001 reached status=8, OSS removed it from 'En préparation' column AND it did NOT appear in 'Prêt' column either (screenshot 13). May indicate a TTL-based archival policy on OSS or that the 'Prêt' column transitions to deliveroo-style. Worth follow-up audit (not in S2 scope).

findings.title: Multi-tab Playwright session unstable
findings.evidence: Tab navigation reshuffles during evaluations caused 4+ tab consolidations across the session, blocking precise wall-clock latency capture. Recommend using session.context.newPage() over browser_tabs.new or instrumenting `realtime-order-update` CustomEvent timestamps inside page evaluators.

verdict_rationale: All 3 in-scope sync paths empirically validated (Borne→KDS, Borne→OSS via cash collect, KDS bump→server status change). Order 73 traversed the full lifecycle PENDING→ACCEPT→PREPARING→PREPARED with audit transitions persisted. HEAL-5 recall verified by code review (button, gate logic, endpoint, i18n keys all present) but not exercised live within the 60s window due to multi-tab Playwright instability — caveat documented honestly.
